description: This file is a shell script used for populating the volatile filesystem during system initialization. It defines functions to create files, directories, and links, and applies configuration files to set up the volatile environment appropriately.

methods.name: create_file
methods.description: Creates a file by touching or copying from a source, sets ownership and permissions.

methods.name: mk_dir
methods.description: Creates a directory with specified permissions and ownership.

methods.name: link_file
methods.description: Creates symbolic links or handles bind mounts, managing existing links or directories.

methods.name: check_requirements
methods.description: Verifies the existence of users and groups required by configuration files.

methods.name: apply_cfgfile
methods.description: Applies configuration files to set up files, directories, and links as specified.
